rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal or metaphorical place in the middle.

example.english: The ball rolled into the midst of the road.
example.jyutping: go3 bo1 luk1 zo2 heoi3 tiu4 lou6 zung1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this especially for something situated among or within a group, situation, or surrounding area.

example.english: In the midst of the crowd, a child kept crying.
example.traditional: 人群當中，有個細路一路喊。
example.jyutping: jan4 kwan4 dong1 zung1 jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 jat1 lou6 haam3

rows.note: Use this when the sense is specifically the central point or focal area of a place or arrangement.

example.english: A Christmas tree was placed in the midst of the square.
example.traditional: 廣場中心擺咗棵聖誕樹。
example.jyutping: gwong2 coeng4 zung1 sam1 baai2 zo2 fo2 sing3 daan3 syu6
